g3ela-how-lens.text: Read the two lenses. Tap the one you will use today.

g3ela-how-virtue.text: Read each moment. Tap Yes or Not yet.

g3ela-proj-wb-welcome.text: Remember the news sellers at the fair? Their broadsides said Jemmy was the rascal. That was wrong! First you’ll make a true Wanted poster for the real outlaws, Hold-Your-Nose Billy and Cutwater. Then you’ll write Jemmy’s letter to the king, telling what really happened. Use what you know from the book. Your work saves as you go.

g3ela-proj-wb-step1.text: Read each clue about Billy. Tap In the book if the book says it, or Not in the book if it doesn’t. Get all eight right to go on.

g3ela-proj-wb-step2.text: Read each clue about Cutwater. Tap In the book if the book says it, or Not in the book if it doesn’t. Get all eight right to go on.

g3ela-proj-wb-step3.text: Draw Billy and Cutwater in the poster frame. Use the true clues. Tap a color, then draw with your finger or your mouse.

g3ela-proj-wb-step4.text: Write what each outlaw looks like, in your own words. Then tap at least two crimes, tap where they were last seen, and type the reward.

g3ela-proj-wb-step5.text: Tap the six events in the order they happen in the book. Then tap Check my order.

g3ela-proj-wb-step6.text: Write what really happened, as Jemmy. Tell one event from the beginning, one from the middle and one from the end. Use First, Next and Last.

g3ela-proj-wb-step7.text: Type the heading. Tap a greeting. Write Jemmy’s opinion of the prince, with a reason and an example. Then tap a closing and sign it.

g3ela-proj-wb-step8.text: Tap each box when your project has it. Then tap Open my PDF pages, and save them as one PDF to turn in on Canvas.
